questions.question: In Disaster Recovery Planning, which term refers to the maximum acceptable data loss measured in terms of time?

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of sequence numbers in the TCP protocol?
options: To count the number of routers in a path
To detect congestion in the network
To identify the receiver’s port number
To ensure data is delivered in correct order
questions.answer: To ensure data is delivered in correct order

questions.question: A network has an MTU of 1500 bits. A data packet of 2000 bits needs to be transmitted. Assuming no header overhead, how many fragments will be created and what will be the size of each?
options: 2 fragments: one of 1500 bits and one of 500 bits
questions.answer: 2 fragments: one of 1500 bits and one of 500 bits

questions.question: What does a router do if it receives an IP packet that is larger than the MTU of the outgoing link and the DF (Don't Fragment) bit is set?
options: Fragments the packet and forwards it
Drops the packet and sends an ICMP "Fragmentation Needed" message
Forwards the packet unchanged to the next router
Reassembles the packet and resends it in parts
Compresses the packet and resends it on the link
questions.answer: Drops the packet and sends an ICMP "Fragmentation Needed" message

questions.question: Which sequence does a DNS resolver follow to translate a domain name into its corresponding IP address?
options: TLD server → root server → authoritative server → returns IP address
Authoritative server → TLD server → root server → returns IP address
Root server → TLD server → authoritative server → returns IP address
TLD server → authoritative server → root server → returns IP address
questions.answer: Root server → TLD server → authoritative server → returns IP address

questions.question: In object-oriented programming, a subclass inherits all members of its base class except:
options: Public members from the base class

What does the term “Internet of Things (IoT)” primarily refer to?
options: A globally distributed ecosystem of AI-enabled embedded systems that autonomously interact with big data engines in real-time through federated learning models.
A dynamic framework where cyber-physical systems utilize blockchain protocols and AI agents to perform autonomous decision-making in fog computing layers.
An interconnected network of physical objects integrated with sensors, actuators, and communication protocols, designed to collect, exchange, and act on real-world data over the internet.
A virtualized cloud infrastructure that supports containerized microservices interacting with machine learning algorithms for large-scale IoT deployment over 5G.
A secure hardware-software ecosystem focused on real-time threat detection and intrusion prevention in smart connected devices using biometric sensors and cryptographic algorithms.
questions.answer: An interconnected network of physical objects integrated with sensors, actuators, and communication protocols, designed to collect, exchange, and act on real-world data over the internet.
